description:
Unveiled in November 2022, the Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato is an off-road variant of the Lamborghini Huracán LP 610-4.

While featuring the same engine as the Lamborghini Huracán EVO, it has numerous upgrades to make the car off-road ready. These include a 1.7 inch increase in ground clearance, a suspension lift, roof rails to attach a roof rack, softer springs and anti roll bars, integrated skidpads and front fog lights. Its new Rally mode optimizes the suspension and all-wheel drive system for off-road use.

The Huracán Sterrato was produced for the 2023 and 2024 model years, with 1,499 examples being produced.
